{{Quote|What's your name?''"<br />"''Grace.''"<br />"''Figures.|Khedryn Faal and Grace|<ref name="Riptide" />}}
'''Grace''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], and one of two daughters of [[Hunter (clone)|Hunter]] and [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha]], two [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] produced on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Born around [[32 ABY/Legends|32 ABY]], Grace lived with her [[Parent/Legends|parents]] and nine other clones secretly produced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the rule of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. These clones, along with their offspring, called themselves the [[Community]]. All the clones, except [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], were afflicted by a life-threatening [[sickness]] which they passed on to their [[Youngling/Legends|children]], including Grace. The symptoms of the sickness were accelerated in [[41 ABY]], when the Community escaped the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and flew through a cloud of [[Lignan]], an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that intensified the effects of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

Hoping to acquire medicine to counteract the sickness's symptoms, the Community flew to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]], where the clone named Soldier carried an unconscious Grace through a [[Farpoint Medical Center|medical center]] and hijacked a medical [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]]. They then left Fhost in search of [[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]], a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] entity worshiped by the Community. Along the way, the supply ship was attacked by the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Nyss Nenn]], who was working for the [[One Sith]]. Nenn [[Death/Legends|killed]] Grace's mother, along with the clone [[Runner (clone)|Runner]], and the clones took their ship to a [[Mother's system|star system]] to find Mother. Upon the Community's arrival, Mother possessed the body of the clone [[Seer (clone)|Seer]] and attempted to kill Grace and Soldier. After Nenn was killed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaden Korr]], Grace and Soldier escaped the system using the Umbaran's starship and went in search of a new home.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Only Grace will live to see Mother.|Seer|<ref name="Riptide" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] Grace was born around [[32 ABY/Legends|32 ABY]] to [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha]] and [[Hunter (clone)|Hunter]], two [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] produced in secret by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the regime of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Alpha and Hunter were bred by [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] in an [[Imperial research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], where they and several other clones, collectively known as the [[Community]], [[Death/Legends|killed]] the doctors and took control of the facility. The clones suffered from a [[sickness]] that contributed to [[clone madness]] and would eventually kill them if not properly treated with a medicine known as [[Metacycline]]. When Hunter gave birth to Grace and her sister Blessing, she passed the sickness on to her daughters, who suffered its effects worse than the clones.<ref name="Riptide" />

The Community waited on the frozen [[Moon/Legends|moon]] for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in the hopes of hijacking a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that could take them to [[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]], an entity that communicated to them through the clone [[Seer (clone)|Seer]].<ref name="Riptide" /> In [[41 ABY]], that wish was granted when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] named [[Jaden Korr]] arrived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] after encountering the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']]. Korr landed on the moon, stalked by [[One Sith]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kell Douro]]. Korr discovered the clones and [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] with Alpha, eventually killing him. Douro was later killed by Korr's companion, the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Khedryn Faal]], and the Community used Douro's [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] [[Predator (Kell Douro's ship)|''Predator'']] to escape the moon.<ref name="Cross">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> In the moon's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] passed through a cloud of [[Lignan]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] caused by the destruction of the ''Harbinger''. The ore granted the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] members of the Community greater power in the use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], but it also accelerated the effects of the sickness. When the Community fell into agony from the sickness's symptoms, [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], a clone of [[Jaden Korr]] and the only member of the Community
who did not suffer from the sickness, injected Grace and the others with Metacycline. He then suggested the Community head to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]], where he hoped they could acquire more of the ingredients necessary for Metacycline. Along the way, Blessing died from the sickness, as did [[Gift]], another [[Youngling/Legends|child]] of the Community's clones. Grace and her mother both survived the journey, but were unconscious. After Soldier injected Grace with a shot of [[Adrenaline/Legends|adrenaline]], he, Seer, and the clone [[Runner (clone)|Runner]] headed to Fhost's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Farpoint]], in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], taking the unconscious Grace and Hunter with them. The Community went to the [[Farpoint Medical Center]], and, after a [[Skirmish at the Farpoint Medical Center|confrontation]] with Jaden Korr, hijacked a [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] and took Korr's companion Faal hostage after knocking him unconscious.<ref name="Riptide" />

Grace reacted well to the medication Soldier gave her, and she regained consciousness aboard the supply ship. Faal later awoke inside the ship's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], where he met Grace. As she smiled at him, he stuck his tongue out at her, causing her to giggle. He was then interrogated by the clones, and, after gleaning what information Faal knew, the clones agreed to kill the spacer. Runner took him to the ship's airlock to eject him into [[Realspace/Legends|space]], but the clone was killed by the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Nyss Nenn]], who had sneaked aboard the ship. Nenn allowed Faal to live with the intention of trading him for Korr, and used a pair of [[flexcuff]]s to restrain the spacer to a crossbar in the ship's corridors. Grace, who had sneaked away from the cockpit, later found Faal and helped free him by giving him a [[Knife/Legends|knife]]. She then fled as her Metacycline began to wear off and the symptoms of the sickness worsened, causing her skin to bulge and roil as it distorted her facial features. Faal considered fleeing the ship in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], but resolved instead to do everything he could to help Grace.<ref name="Riptide" />

Hunter regained consciousness and went out looking for Grace, but she too encountered Nenn, who killed her with his [[Crossbow/Legends|crossbow]]. The Umbaran then went to the cockpit to capture Soldier. As he stood outside the cockpit, hoping to surprise Soldier and Seer, Grace spotted him and screamed, alerting the clones. Nenn tried to throw a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] at her, but she ran away before he could. As Soldier fought with the Umbaran, Grace ran to a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] and took it down to the floor where she had found Faal. Faal, waiting at the lift several floors down, was prepared to see the Umbaran or a clone inside the lift, and nearly attacked Grace when she emerged. Instead, he comforted the frightened girl, who told him about the situation at the cockpit.<ref name="Riptide" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Where is Runner?''"<br />"''I don't know. What's your name?''"<br />"''I'm glad he didn't hurt you.|Grace and Khedryn Faal|<ref name="Riptide" />}}
While often very shy when attention was on her, the [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] Grace could be very outgoing, even to strangers. When Khedryn Fall was knocked unconscious and taken aboard the Community's hijacked supply ship, Grace immediately interacted with him when he awoke, smiling at him and giggling when he stuck his tongue out in return. Despite the girl's unusual upbringing, Faal remarked to himself that she behaved like any little girl in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. She was often kind to everyone around her; although Soldier was often the target of cruelty and violence from the rest of the Community, Grace was open and loving toward him, and Soldier cared deeply for her and the other children despite feeling apathetic toward the other clones. Grace's kindness extended even to Faal, whom she hardly knew, and she expressed to him her happiness when she saw that Runner had not harmed him. Despite being frightened when Faal nearly attacked her with a knife, she remained kind to him and giggled at his jokes.<ref name="Riptide" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clones of the Community were first introduced in ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', a [[2010]] novel written by [[Paul S. Kemp]]. Jaden Korr remarks in the novel that the clones may have had offspring, which was proven true in ''Crosscurrent''{{'s}} [[2011]] sequel, [[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']], in which Grace makes her first appearance.
